import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    private void run() {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
             PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
            
            int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
            if (n > 11) {
                pw.println("0");
                return;
            }
            
            List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                String[] coords = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
                points.add(new Point(
                    Integer.parseInt(coords[0]),
                    Integer.parseInt(coords[1]),
                    Integer.parseInt(coords[2]),
                    Integer.parseInt(coords[3]),
                    Integer.parseInt(coords[4])
                ));
            }
            
            Set<Integer> goodIndices = new TreeSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                boolean isGood = true;
                for (int j = 0; j < n && isGood; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n && isGood; k++) {
                        if (i != j && i != k && j != k) {
                            Point v1 = points.get(j).subtract(points.get(i));
                            Point v2 = points.get(k).subtract(points.get(i));
                            if (dotProduct(v1, v2) > 0) {
                                isGood = false;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (isGood) {
                    goodIndices.add(i + 1);
                }
            }
            
            if (goodIndices.isEmpty()) {
                pw.println("0");
            } else {
                pw.println(goodIndices.size());
                for (int idx : goodIndices) {
                    pw.println(idx);
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
    
    private static class Point {
        int v, w, x, y, z;
        
        Point(int v, int w, int x, int y, int z) {
            this.v = v;
            this.w = w;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.z = z;
        }
        
        Point subtract(Point other) {
            return new Point(
                this.v - other.v,
                this.w - other.w,
                this.x - other.x,
                this.y - other.y,
                this.z - other.z
            );
        }
        
        double magnitude() {
            return Math.sqrt(v*v + w*w + x*x + y*y + z*z);
        }
    }
    
    private static double dotProduct(Point a, Point b) {
        return (double)(a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z);
    }
}
